commit 2408eaf92aa0a196cd4984ccca7e0a95f268def7
Author:     Toby Pilling <toby@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Fri Jul 11 18:02:21 2025 +0000

CommitDate: Fri Jul 11 18:02:21 2025 +0000

    Bug 1970615 - Register IMAP protocol early to avoid session restore issues. r=darktrojan,kaie
    
    
    When we got rid of IMAP JS, that removed a call to the ModuleLoader which previously checked a pref to either register the JS version or the C++ version. We still need that early registration to avoid session restore situations like a PDF that was previously open in a tab. Maybe we should have kept that...
    https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D237996#inline-1318902
    
    Ah well, this should do it.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D257039

diff --git a/mail/components/MailGlue.sys.mjs b/mail/components/MailGlue.sys.mjs
index 8db72cf5989..7e4b5d480c7 100644
--- a/mail/components/MailGlue.sys.mjs
+++ b/mail/components/MailGlue.sys.mjs
@@ -464,6 +464,10 @@ MailGlue.prototype = {
         // in message databases, causing massive amounts of I/O.
         Services.perms.all;
 
+        // Force early registration of the IMAP protocol handler to avoid
+        // session restore failures.
+        Cc["@mozilla.org/network/protocol;1?name=imap"].getService();
+
         Cc["@mozilla.org/msgFolder/msgFolderService;1"]
           .getService(Ci.nsIMsgFolderService)
           .initializeFolderStrings();
title: Bug 1970615 - Register IMAP protocol early to avoid session restore issues. r=darktrojan,kaie
